subjective.text: Full name is Sarah Smith with date of birth November 2, 1992.
Sarah has been experiencing fever for about seven days and feels generally unwell.
She is taking over-the-counter medications including ibuprofen and paracetamol but they are not helping her symptoms.
Sarah has a habit of sweating all day long and feeling nauseous without any other specific symptom like cough or sore throat.
She had malaria preventative medication while in Vietnam but cannot remember the exact type.
Sarah works as a nurse and is currently struggling with fatigue at work due to her symptoms.
She does not have any known allergies except for hay fever.

objective.text: Doctor Dean examined Sarah and noted her general unwell appearance and symptoms of fever, sweating, nausea, muscle aches, and fatigue.

assessment.text: Sarah is likely suffering from an undiagnosed infection possibly related to her recent trip to Vietnam.
She may have developed malaria or other exotic infections due to her travel history.
Her symptoms suggest a systemic illness that needs further investigation and testing.

plan.text: Doctor Dean plans for Sarah to be examined in the clinic, where blood tests will be arranged based on examination findings.
Sarah is advised not to return to work until her condition is sorted out and she needs to follow up with the clinic after her appointment.
